ModMetaData.name: RimMult
ModMetaData.author: Vanket
ModMetaData.description:
Multiplayer for RimWorld 1.6 — 2 to 10 players over Steam.
SEPARATE COLONIES: every player has their own colony on one shared planet, with a shared clock (speed by vote). Send goods and colonists to each other, trade by caravan, make alliances and wars. Raid another player — AI-led, or in person: you join their game and command your fighters while they defend. Help an ally in person on their quests or against raids.
CO-OP: everyone plays the host's colony, live: orders, designations, bills, storage, policies, schedules, quests, caravans.
Each machine simulates only its own game, so there are no desyncs from mods and weaker PCs keep a good framerate. A dedicated server (Linux/Windows/Docker) is available on GitHub.
Мультиплеер для RimWorld 1.6 — от 2 до 10 игроков через Steam: раздельные колонии на одной планете (торговля, союзы, войны, рейды лично, помощь союзнику) или кооп в колонии хоста. Выделенный сервер — на GitHub.
Early version: please report problems with the "Bug report" button in the multiplayer window.
